title: BlockMeta
description: Metadata for a single TSDB block managed by the Compactor.

minTime.description: Minimum timestamp in milliseconds for data in this block.

maxTime.description: Maximum timestamp in milliseconds for data in this block.

compaction.description: Compaction metadata tracking the block's compaction history.

level.description: Compaction level. Raw blocks start at level 1; each compaction pass increments the level.

sources.description: ULIDs of source blocks merged to create this block.

labels.description: External labels identifying the origin of this block.

resolution.description: Resolution in milliseconds. 0 for raw, 300000 for 5-minute, 3600000 for 1-hour downsampled data.

source.description: Thanos component that produced this block.
